decision_record: Baseline development/validation results are already known. Graph historical returns have not yet been computed in this milestone. The new settings below are fixed before that comparison.
sensitivity_rule: Evaluate all three diffusion times at all four trading fees, retaining the baseline. Secondary scenarios are descriptive; do not select a new primary model.
borrow_rule: At 5 bps, compare baseline and primary graph at every declared borrow rate. Reuse the 2% primary results.
exposure_control: At each decision date, scale each primary target vector down to the smaller of their two gross exposures. Compare both controls at 5 bps and 2% borrow. This controller is causal and preserves the original name caps and linear neutrality constraints.

uncertainty.contrast: graph_tau_1 net daily return minus baseline net daily return at 5 bps and 2% borrow
uncertainty.reported_estimand: 252 times the arithmetic mean paired daily difference, not CAGR difference
uncertainty.resampling_unit: paired daily return difference within each evaluation phase, with circular continuation and geometric block lengths
uncertainty.limitations: Conditional on the realised policies and selected basket. No price-path reconstruction or model refitting; pointwise approximate intervals assume adequate stationarity/weak dependence and do not correct selection or survivorship bias.

comparison_gate: Report signed return differences, costs, turnover, gross exposure, volatility and uncertainty. Improvement relative to baseline is not equivalent to profitability. No final holdout or parameter selection is permitted.
registration: Local hash record, not externally registered preregistration.
